# Civ4 Archipelago Mod
An attempt at making a mod for Civ4 that integrates Archipelago connections

notes.text:
A mix of bug fixes, quality of life, and one new feature in this release. The main additions are new locations from Resourcesanity (but note a bug that needs to be worked around in this release!) and the ability to peek what items will be sent when you spend a Great Person (with other types of peeks coming soon).

### Changelog:
- Resourcesanity is available in an initial form. A check is sent when you have at least one instance of a resource available in your capital, either by connecting it naturally or getting it via trade. The logic makes sure you have the techs needed to reveal and connect the given resource (or make a corporation for it in the case of Aluminum and Oil), and additionally requires Iron Working to connect Calendar resources (as the majority of them are placed in jungle on "normal" maps). You also aren't guaranteed to have every resource on every map and may need to generate another game to get all checks.
- If Peekable Locations is set to either "Great People" or "All" in the YAML, the option to "bulb" a location will show the name of the item you're sending. In this initial implementation GPs are the only location that's peekable, it doesn't say who the item is for, or what type the item is (Progression/Useful/Filler/Trap), all of which are planned for later updates.
- Fixed Archipelago Communism being named Archipelago Utopia, causing the location not to send.
- Did lots of refactoring and code cleanup that's not interesting to users

### Installation Instructions:
1. Unzip Civ4-Archipelago-Mod into your Beyond the Sword mod folder (I've been testing it in the My Games one, but theoretically it should also work in the installation folder one; let me know if one or both work or don't work!), make sure the structure is Beyond the Sword/Mods/Civ4-Archipelago-Mod and that there isn't an extra folder in that structure.
2. Install the APWorld as normal.

### Play Instructions:
1. Run the Civilization IV client from Archipelago, but **do not connect from the client**; you'll do so in-game (and eventually I want to remove the ability to connect from the client)
2. Start a new Civ4 Beyond the Sword game as normal--**I highly recommend playing in windowed mode**, since this is an alpha and if the game freezes it can be difficult/impossible to close out of it if it's in full screen mode.
3. When you load in you'll get a popup saying to connect to the Archipelago Server: you do this by opening up the BUG options (the little dragon in the upper-right corner), entering in your information, then clicking "Save and Connect." If the connection is successful you'll get a popup that says "Successfully Connected," and you can play as normal. If you get an error, try connecting again, it most often means you don't have the client open or you're already connected in the client. Occasionally however the connection will be slow and you connect in the client but get an error in-game; in that case disconnect in the client and try again. **If this happens a lot to you let me know!**

### Gameplay Issues:
1. If a resource is made obsolete (Fur, Whale, and Ivory from Plastics, Combustion, and Industrialism respectively) it will not send! The easiest way to fix this is removing the tech in World Builder for a turn, sending the check, then re-adding the tech.
2. You can still receive techs in Techsanity from some ways that aren't traditional research: starting techs from your leader and tech trading, and this could lead to duplicates. These are planned to be removed in future updates. Let me know if things break because of them--they shouldn't, but I'm not 100% certain.
3. The settings aren't balanced at all, and it may make you do things like get 9 Great Scientists when all you have is the library or research Satellites before you have any economic techs. The Techsanity Era Gates setting should help the latter, and I'd highly recommend against large GPsanity numbers unless you have a lot of time to kill (though the added Great People in the pool will help).
4. There are a lot of debugging messages left in the mod. I removed some of them, but don't expect a clean feed.
5. When you're trying to select an "obsolete" wonder to build in the city screen, the building options will jump to the top of the building list due to the hacky way I've implemented that ability. I want to fix it eventually, but for now the easiest way to mitigate it is to use the wonder filter on the right side of the city list (the star), which will have it jump back to the start of the wonders, which hopefully won't make it jump. You can also use the "choose what to build next" dialog, or just select it without moving your mouse (use the scroll wheel).
6. The "AP" Unique Units can't be upgraded into, though they can be upgraded themselves. This is planned to be fixed in an upcoming update.
7. AP Unique Buildings are programmed assuming you don't have a "natural" Unique Building for your Civilization for purposes like avoiding duplicates of the same class of building, so if you use a Civilization other than AP World things could break.
8. If a building has a requirement to be built (such as the University), and you build an AP Unique Building version of it (such as the Seowon), you aren't able to build the original version anymore. There's no reason why you'd need to do this (the only vanilla building that's not strictly worse than the UB alternatives is the Theatre/Hippodrome, and that doesn't suffer the bug), but it's weird behavior.

### Technical Issues:
1. I had generation errors when creating solo/near-solo multiworlds with high Techsanity Era Gates values--I never tested with higher values with locations other than Techsanity enabled but keep that in mind if you're having trouble generating.
2. Whenever you close and reopen the game/a save file, you need to disconnect the client, and you should close and reopen the client to avoid missing checks. I plan to try and automate this in future updates.
3. There have been bug reports of items received/obtained while offline not properly appearing in-game and/or being sent to the multiworld when reconnecting. I think this is related to mismatching either mod or APworld versions, but I haven't fully found the root cause yet.
4. If you add Unique Buildings to the itempool, it causes a noticeable amount of lag when entering the city screen in some cases (due to the coding I need to make them work how I want them to). I think it scales with the amount of cities you have, but it also might be just a memory leak. If you experience this lag (or don't and think you would), let me know!

If you have any questions, bug reports, or things I forgot to mention, let me know in [the Civilization IV thread in the Archipelago Discord server](https://discord.com/channels/731205301247803413/1326231506682904576).

Github for the APWorld: https://github.com/VincentBorchardt/Archipelago/blob/main/worlds/civ_4/
